ATM and BTC Update On October 26, 2026, Strategy Inc ("Strategy") announced that, during the period from October 19, 2026 to October 25, 2026, Strategy did not sell any shares under its at-the-market offering program and did not purchase or sell any bitcoin. As of October 25, 2026, Strategy holds approximately 848,517 bitcoin that were acquired at an aggregate purchase price of $64.02 billion and an average purchase price of approximately $75,446 per bitcoin, inclusive of fees and expenses. USD Reserve and USD Cash Updates As part of its capital framework, Strategy maintains: (i) a U.S. dollar reserve (the "USD Reserve"), which is intended to support the payment of dividends on Strategy's preferred stock and interest on its outstanding indebtedness, and (ii) "USD Cash", which management maintains to deploy for broader general Bitcoin Treasury Company purposes, which may include acquiring bitcoin, expanding the USD Reserve, broader capital management uses, and other similar purposes. During the period from October 19, 2026 to October 25, 2026, Strategy used $204.9 million of USD Cash to fund repurchases of STRC Stock. As of October 25, 2026, the balances of the USD Reserve and USD Cash were $4.83 billion and $242.4 million, respectively. Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure. Strategy Dashboard Strategy also maintains a dashboard on its website (www.strategy.com) as a disclosure channel for providing broad, non-exclusionary distribution of information regarding Strategy to the public, including information regarding market prices of its outstanding securities, bitcoin purchases and holdings, certain key performance indicator metrics and other supplemental information, and as one means of disclosing non-public information in compliance with its disclosure obligations under Regulation FD. Investors and others are encouraged to regularly review the information that Strategy makes public via the website dashboard. Item 1.01. Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement. On October 25, 2026, Range Resources Corporation, a Delaware corporation (“ Range ”), entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “ Merger Agreement ”) with EQT Corporation, a Pennsylvania corporation (“ EQT ”), EQT Holdings LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of EQT, Rhino Merger Sub Inc., a Delaware corporation and an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of EQT (“ Merger Sub ”), and Rhino Merger Sub LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of EQT (“ LLC Sub ”). Upon the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in the Merger Agreement, which has been unanimously approved by the board of directors of Range and the board of directors of EQT (the “ EQT Board ”), Merger Sub will merge with and into Range (the “ First Merger ”), with Range surviving as an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of EQT (the “ First Step Surviving Corporation ”), and as the second step in a single integrated transaction with the First Merger, the First Step Surviving Corporation will merge with and into LLC Sub (the “ Second Merger ” and, together with the First Merger, the “ Mergers ”), with LLC Sub surviving the Second Merger as an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of EQT. At the effective time of the First Merger (the “ Effective Time ”), among other things, each share of common stock, par value $0.01 per share, of Range (“ Range Common Stock ”) that is issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time (including Range restricted stock awards but excluding Excluded Shares (as defined in the Merger Agreement)) will be converted into the right to receive, without interest, 0.987 (the “ Exchange Ratio ”) shares of common stock, no par value, of EQT (“ EQT Common Stock ”). Cash will be paid in lieu of any fractional shares of EQT Common Stock that otherwise would have been issued to any Range stockholder in the Mergers. Following the closing of the Mergers (the “ Closing ”), Range’s existing stockholders and EQT’s existing stockholders will own approximately 27% and 73%, respectively, of the combined company on a fully diluted basis. Governance In the Merger Agreement, EQT has agreed to increase the size of the EQT Board to 12 members and appoint Dennis L. Degner and one other individual selected by Range (who shall satisfy the independence requirements of the New York Stock Exchange (the “ NYSE ”) with respect to service on the EQT Board), after reasonable consultation with EQT and with the consent of EQT (not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed) (the “ Range Designees ”), to the EQT Board at the Effective Time. EQT has also agreed that, following the Closing, EQT will take all necessary action to nominate the Range Designees for election to the EQT Board at the first annual meeting of shareholders of EQT thereafter. [Benzinga news, 2026-10-26T10:31:56Z, by staff] Bristol Myers Squibb and SystImmune Announce Positive Phase 3 Results for Izalontamab Brengitecan in NSCLC
Bristol Myers Squibb and partner SystImmune reported positive interim results from the Phase 3 PANKU-Lung01 study, showing that the drug candidate izalontamab brengitecan (Iza-Bren) doubled median progression-free survival in patients with previously-treated EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer.
Bristol Myers Squibb and SystImmune, a subsidiary of Sichuan Biokin Pharmaceutical, announced positive interim analysis results from the Phase 3 PANKU-Lung01 clinical trial. The study evaluated izalontamab brengitecan (Iza-Bren), an EGFRxHER3 bispecific antibody-drug conjugate, in patients with previously-treated EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Results indicated that the treatment doubled median progression-free survival compared to chemotherapy. Bristol Myers Squibb management highlighted the findings as an important inflection point for the asset, noting its potential to address significant unmet needs across multiple tumor types. The company is currently advancing the development of Iza-Bren as part of its oncology portfolio.
